name: VistaHaven
summary: Clean white agency site with a rounded inset photo hero, uppercase Geist headlines, pill badges and a notched-corner image card motif.

fonts.pairing: Geist 600 uppercase for headings, Geist 300 for body and big light numerals

signature: inset 32px-radius hero photo whose bottom-right corner is cut out to hold an overlapping agent-avatar rating chip
service accordion where inactive items collapse into vertical rotated uppercase labels beside the active image
imagery: twilight modern glass houses with warm interior light, crisp architectural daylight shots, corporate team portraits
layout_grid: 1280px canvas, 80px side padding, 80px section padding, 160px between subsections, 3-column card and listing grids, 32px radii
